[NDBG.14.17.1] A session holds **timelines**: the real run, and each
hypothesis fork the session has opened. A fork starts at a position in
another timeline with one change there: an inject ([NDBG.14.13.1],
[NDBG.14.14.1]), or a mock that answers a recorded call differently
([NDBG.14.15.2]). Opening a fork switches the session to it. A fork's firings
have thread ids of their own ([NDBG.10.1.2]), and `restart` drops every fork
([NDBG.9.3.2]).
